independent_evaluator: EXTERNAL (not GPT-6 High, Instant, CodeQL or self-audit)

tasks.work: Read HANDOFF→STATUS→AGENTS→REQUIREMENTS→FINAL_DESIGN→scorecard→latest source; compare repo branch and PR SHA.
tasks.acceptance: Enumerate actual 33/100, 22 VERIFIED, 11 PENDING, latest tested code SHA separately from docs HEAD.
tasks.evidence: Read-only SHA, scorecard contract, baseline diff in STATUS.

tasks.work: Secure previous non-destructive rollback reference and inventory customer/REA_Web protected paths; check auth identity, existing branch and CI budget.
tasks.acceptance: Explicit rollback SHA and original/no-overwrite boundary; no new branch/release/repo/rights change.
tasks.evidence: Git commit parent SHA + protected paths listed; no private materials.

tasks.work: Open evidence index per R with unique opaque IDs and a public-safe checklist; no customer names, data, screenshots, private paths or permission tokens.
tasks.acceptance: Each R07/R21/R25/R26/R29 evidence indexed as VERIFIED/INCOMPLETE/MISSING without assigning points.
tasks.evidence: New redacted evidence reference index and missing list.

tasks.work: Freeze regression commands against the last feature SHA; classify existing hosted/synthetic results as such, no buyer-acceptance assertion.
tasks.acceptance: No regression and no mistaken CI-Ready=customer-approved claim.
tasks.evidence: Test run URLs exact SHA, PASS/FAIL/SKIP log and OS/browser scope.

tasks.work: Map raw-source custody, user-of-record, owner-created copies, browser plaintext output and shared-data rights; reuse existing order_intake_preflight to avoid duplicate workflow.
tasks.acceptance: Data flow states input rights, no cloud upload, source hash invariance, unsafe types HOLD; missing legal rights clearly isolated.
tasks.evidence: Redacted dataflow/threat review linked to source SHA.

tasks.work: Prepare per-order right-to-use/transform/distribute confirmation checklist, user/third-party shared rights distinction, plaintext delivery and revocation triggers; only anonymous template.
tasks.acceptance: Specific customer/source/authority/consent/date scope fields for future private records; no fictional signatures or third-party agreement.
tasks.evidence: Unfilled and redacted customer-rights form; review labels not approvals.

tasks.work: Audit both desktop single/batch consent-reset paths and CLI on source/sheet/header/ID mapping/file replacement; fix only reproduced omission.
tasks.acceptance: Invalid/missing consent or changed input fails closed; source bytes and existing customer outputs identical to pretest.
tasks.evidence: Synthetic changed-source SHA, direct CLI and GUI regression evidence.

tasks.work: Confirm actual rights/authority and obtain specific owner/provider permission plus scope for one authorized acceptance case using approved private/local channel only.
tasks.acceptance: Real source authorization and consent can be independently checked; no private proof or source uploaded to public GitHub/ChatGPT.
tasks.evidence: Owner/customer dated authorization held privately; GitHub only opaque status/reviewer reference.

tasks.work: Review rights/consent provenance and source-before/after SHA, exact tested code SHA and residual privacy limits.
tasks.acceptance: Entire R07 source preservation + actual rights/consent satisfied; otherwise leave R07 PENDING.
tasks.evidence: Signed/referenced High item-level review without customer data in repo.

tasks.work: Reconcile actual zipped HTML, manifest and README with local receipt, source Git blob pins, all shipped CSS/JS/vendor assets, excluded EXE/test deps.
tasks.acceptance: Complete real A shipping inventory vs whitelist; all provenance unknowns labeled pending, no fake LICENSE.
tasks.evidence: Git-linked inventory with source SHA and actual synthetic ZIP member evidence.

tasks.work: For every shipped asset/derivation enumerate author, origin SHA, upstream reference, vendor license/NOTICE obligations and unresolved chains; do not infer IP ownership from AI generation or GitHub owner.
tasks.acceptance: Every actually shipped text/JS/CSS artifact has a rights-evidence or explicit unresolved flag; no accidental EXE bundling.
tasks.evidence: Versioned chain-of-title/third-party dependency matrix, unknowns kept as blockers.

tasks.work: Obtain actual rights-holder confirmation or license for derived code/templates, commercial redistribution scope and any third-party NOTICE; explicitly decide customer usage terms.
tasks.acceptance: Rights documents and each required notice licensed for the actual A deliverable; not merely owner planning direction.
tasks.evidence: Private owner/legal/rights-holder evidence and public-safe approval scope, reviewer ID.

tasks.work: Only after verified rights decision: choose (1) no extra member when legally justified; or (2) versioned approved LICENSE/NOTICE packaging contract, migrating builder/verifier/receipt together without breaking v1.
tasks.acceptance: Allowed contents match actual authorized rights text and deterministic ZIP, versioned v2 when needed; no overwrite, no invented license.
tasks.evidence: Exact legal text provenance ref, package contract version, signed owner authorization, code diff.

tasks.work: Run synthetic allowed/forbidden license member, duplicate/ZIP-slip/modified notice, old v1 compatibility, receipt hash and create-only failure rollback.
tasks.acceptance: Valid authorized package passes independent verifier; malicious/unapproved member and old-data corruption fail closed, old v1 still accepted.
tasks.evidence: Windows/Ubuntu and Chrome/Edge exact-SHA source/test evidence, ZIP hash and manifest contract.

tasks.work: Review owner/third-party rights proof, final shipped bytes and license text/NOTICE obligations, migration, exact-SHA CI.
tasks.acceptance: Entire R21 including real commercial use permission and v1/v2 verifier correctness accepted or 4 points stay pending.
tasks.evidence: High item review and exact rights decision reference, not hypothetical license.

tasks.work: Map owner-approved max 7-day temporary operator copy, earlier purpose-completion handling, legal exceptions, originals/outputs never auto-delete; compare current retention utility.
tasks.acceptance: No accidental deletion/upload; policy mismatch fails closed and actual disposal is not certified by metadata.
tasks.evidence: Policy-vs-code map and synthetic time boundary tests.

tasks.work: Prepare an unfilled custody/owner role, where/when data copied, rights, purpose, manual deletion or return authority, legal exception and record checklist.
tasks.acceptance: Customer source and result retention separate; explicit records for custody, expiry, action and no-copy case; no customer identifiers in public repo.
tasks.evidence: Redacted receipt/retention notice and operator manual checklist.

tasks.work: Actually confirm responsible operator, permitted custody, disposal/return procedure and where separate private evidence is retained; execute a real authorized no-copy/copy-retention acceptance trace.
tasks.acceptance: Owner explicitly owns policy and genuine handling log exists; never claim physical deletion without action evidence.
tasks.evidence: Private acceptance evidence/ref, public-safe policy signoff only.

tasks.work: Compare actual operator evidence with source-preservation, duration and manual-only protocol; check legal exceptions not silently bypassed.
tasks.acceptance: Complete R25 policy notice and actual accountable practice satisfied; else hold.
tasks.evidence: High item review plus retention acceptance reference.

tasks.work: Reconcile personal/sensitive/medical/payment identifiers, shared/confidential, unknown scope, allowed nonpersonal only; map plaintext and offline exposure.
tasks.acceptance: Default HOLD for personal/sensitive/unclear rights and explicit safe classification; no encryption/anonymous-data fiction.
tasks.evidence: Synthetic privacy class matrix, mappings and negative cases.

tasks.work: Audit frontend checkbox reset for replaced/altered source, rights, plaintext and privacy classification across single and batch; update tests only for reproduced gap.
tasks.acceptance: No persistence of stale sensitive approval across dataset revisions; file values not sent over network.
tasks.evidence: CI/browser negative-flow evidence, clear notices/HOLD response.

tasks.work: For an actual lawful use case obtain owner and client decisions about data type/accessors/retention/transfers, explicit plaintext use and whether sensitive-data flow is rejected.
tasks.acceptance: Specific scoped customer agreement or documented nonpersonal-only boundary; no blanket approval inferred.
tasks.evidence: Private dated consent and operator acceptance; public-safe redacted reference.

tasks.work: Verify privacy scope and actual permission against implementation and plaintext warnings; never treat program checkbox alone as legal agreement.
tasks.acceptance: Full R26 personally sensitive data handling/rejection and real consent scope accepted; otherwise pending.
tasks.evidence: High item review plus consent reference.

tasks.work: Freeze independent evaluator's threat scope: XSS/CSP/CSV formula, XLSX zip bomb and XML entities, ZIP/receipt, TOCTOU symlink/hardlink/junction, interruptions, offline network.
tasks.acceptance: Threat matrix has reproducible positive/negative test cases, supported OS constraints and residual risks; no claim of external audit.
tasks.evidence: Synthetic case inventory, fixture hashes, exact source SHA.

tasks.work: Prepare public-source-only reproducible audit bundle/instructions, source freeze and risk register, with existing internal CodeQL and browser CI clearly labeled self-check.
tasks.acceptance: Another evaluator can independently run tests without customer data, secrets, private access or false PASS.
tasks.evidence: SHA-pin commands/expected outputs and failure reporting template.

tasks.work: Select/approve a genuinely independent external reviewer and specific scope, any agreement or public-source sharing, zero-cost budget; no paid purchase or access grant absent new approval.
tasks.acceptance: Documented external evaluator independence, permitted public-only materials and no unauthorized spend/transmission.
tasks.evidence: Owner approval/evaluator identity scope held privately, public-safe reference.

tasks.work: Independently reproduce attack matrix against frozen exact SHA in real supported environments and issue dated findings with severity, omissions, environment, command logs.
tasks.acceptance: Actual independent signed/attributable findings and limit descriptions, not a self-run AI/CodeQL report.
tasks.evidence: External SHA-pinned review report, anonymized location and finding IDs.

tasks.work: Implement least-invasive fixes for confirmed external findings, preserve originals/v1 ZIP and no-network contract, add reproducing regressions.
tasks.acceptance: Each finding has fix commit or documented accepted blocker, Windows/Ubuntu/browser CI on exact fix SHA.
tasks.evidence: Finding→fix SHA→test table, data and secrets absent.

tasks.work: Same independent evaluator retests fixes on new SHA, records unfixable risks, gaps, and signoff/remaining-blocker status.
tasks.acceptance: External final retest confirms closure or explicitly blocks R29; no self-signed completion.
tasks.evidence: Independent dated recheck SHA report, signed/attributable reviewer.

tasks.work: Independently review external reviewer identity, scope completeness, outstanding findings, SHA and field/OS limits; don't conflate High with external.
tasks.acceptance: Complete R29 acceptance only after external signoff and verified no blocking findings; else PENDING.
tasks.evidence: High R29 score review linking external IDs and code SHA.

tasks.work: Assemble five complete item-level evidence packets with provenance and no private material in repo; reconcile 2+4+2+2+3 points.
tasks.acceptance: Each requirement fully accepted independently; none receives partial point for templates, self tests or false attestations.
tasks.evidence: R07/R21/R25/R26/R29 acceptance matrix, exact SHA of reviewed functionality.

tasks.work: Run last exact-code-SHA Windows/Ubuntu Python, Chrome/Edge/Chromium, portable v1/v2, privacy/R21/R29 regression and CodeQL using existing free runners.
tasks.acceptance: All required CI jobs SUCCESS at exact code SHA with PASS/FAIL/SKIP, browser assets/API/zip/receipt intact; buyer acceptance separate.
tasks.evidence: Actions URL/run/job, browser and no-network evidence; no doc-SHA confusion.

tasks.work: Only if five full acceptance proofs exist and independent High item reviews agree, update those five R states in existing 100-point locked scorecard; no weight changes; run score checker.
tasks.acceptance: Score mechanically equals 85/100, 33 items and 100 denominator unchanged, all five VERIFIED and other six PENDING; publish audit diff.
tasks.evidence: Scorecard JSON diff, exact SHA score command and evidence links.

tasks.work: High final milestone gate: confirm source SHA CI, complete real rights/consent/retention/legal/independent audit evidence, no sale or customer upload authorized by score.
tasks.acceptance: Authorize 85 report only when all five complete; otherwise return blocked IDs to Instant and preserve prior score; keep RELEASE HOLD.
tasks.evidence: High acceptance memo with item verdicts, STATUS/HANDOFF consistency.

tasks.work: Prepare exact browser/OS supported acceptance script for Win10/11 Chrome/Edge and macOS/Linux, real file:// access, ZIP + print/mobile, network0.
tasks.acceptance: Independent examiner reproducible steps and evidence intake fields.
tasks.evidence: Device/browser matrix and safe synthetic benchmark.

tasks.work: Independent real supported buyer device tests, including full Win10/11 in contract, macOS/Linux additional cases; collect no sensitive uploads.
tasks.acceptance: Every mandated OS/browser combination supported or explicitly blocked; buyer proof not hosted CI.
tasks.evidence: Independent version/environment/device acceptance.

tasks.work: Reconcile SKU BASIC/PRO/BUSINESS data limits, revisions, support, refund non-waiver, platform fee and tax conditions against code and owners 0-cost internal defaults.
tasks.acceptance: Pricing/service/refund page contains no unsupported claim and no auto-listing.
tasks.evidence: Draft publish-ready but unpublished SKU/FAQ/checklist.

tasks.work: Explicitly approve real listing price and actual platform/tax/business support/refund operations separate from the internal zero-upfront defaults.
tasks.acceptance: Final operator policy signed off; posting/sale remains separate release decision.
tasks.evidence: Private owner business approval and public-safe decision.

tasks.work: Build customer-safe real E2E runbook for approved source, SHA, print, XLSX/TSV/batch, output compare, error/log redaction.
tasks.acceptance: Runbook and independent examiner run reproduce end-to-end flow without leaked originals.
tasks.evidence: Per-OS sanitized actual E2E evidence.

tasks.work: Complete independent actual-user E2E and packaging/signing/licensing review in required OS/browser environments.
tasks.acceptance: Human test evidence, remediation and acceptable remaining limitations; no hosted-only substitution.
tasks.evidence: External customer acceptance/test transcript; private source restricted.

tasks.work: Audit clean Python/portable/Windows owner preview build reproducibility, executable dependencies + licensing, offline installation/uninstallation and rollback instructions; no B commercial distribution.
tasks.acceptance: Repeatable clean build hashes and commands, dependency manifests and CI success; non-free signing or installer gating flagged.
tasks.evidence: Build manifest/binary SHA/runner version/NOTICE table, no customer data.

tasks.work: Approve bounded intended executable distribution/support/signing approach and rights after field test; costs require separate explicit advance approval; no paid signing assumed.
tasks.acceptance: User acceptance of reproducible actual delivery/runtime and safe rights; B remains unsigned preview until separate GO.
tasks.evidence: Owner/independent build-rights and device evidence.

tasks.work: Review R23=3,R27=2,R30=2,R32=3 full evidence, rerun score/CI and update only verified items through Instant.
tasks.acceptance: If and only if four complete items accepted, confirmed score=95/100; sale still HOLD.
tasks.evidence: High milestone review, revised exact SHA scorecard/CI and handoff.

tasks.work: Reassess file replacement/collision/TOCTOU, hardlink and Windows reparse, identity snapshots and OS concurrency; compare OS-specific secure-handle plan vs fail-closed documented limitation.
tasks.acceptance: Demonstrated deterministic OS-specific race regression and safe source/target preservation; no claim fully atomic without proof.
tasks.evidence: Adversarial synthetic+real OS evidence and design decision.

tasks.work: Independent runtime tester exercises scoped realistic concurrent source/destination file swaps on supported Windows and Linux, records failures and mitigation acceptance.
tasks.acceptance: Source SHA/size/bytes, customer folder race and residual risk accepted on real OS; otherwise R06 pending.
tasks.evidence: Independent OS/TOCTOU final acceptance, exact code SHA.

tasks.work: Verify full commercial IP chain, actual buyer data use and redistribution rights, public deliverable contents, legal refund support obligations and final owner acceptance.
tasks.acceptance: Real lawful source/contract/license/right holder and signed commercial operational authorization; no AI-created evidence.
tasks.evidence: Private owner/legal/customer rights record with redacted public index.

tasks.work: Obtain actual buyer acceptance evidence and legitimate purchase/refund lifecycle operational proof under approved marketplace terms; no artificial order or fake sale.
tasks.acceptance: Independent legitimate buyer/customer acceptance and lifecycle, or remain blocked pending actual buyer.
tasks.evidence: Private customer/marketplace evidence and compliant redacted reference.

tasks.work: Cross-check exact delivered artifact and receipt SHA/rights/acceptance with actual signed operational evidence, without posting, charging, uploading or changing security policy.
tasks.acceptance: No inconsistency between contract/ZIP/source/SKU/consumer rights; no automatic release GO.
tasks.evidence: Legal+technical signoff matrix, evidence redacted.

tasks.work: Re-run full regression and entire 33-item acceptance ledger; only after R06/R33 full evidence change scorecard, run exact SHA gates and prepare support/rollback handoff.
tasks.acceptance: 100/100 mechanically and evidentially justified, 33/33 VERIFIED, no missing independent evidence, original files preserved.
tasks.evidence: Exact SHA 3OS/real buyer/independent reports, reviewer approval matrix and scorecard.

tasks.work: Independent High end-to-end final audit of code+CI, UI/browser, artifacts, legal/privacy/customer evidence, security, origin and score; separate commercial release authorization from 100%.
tasks.acceptance: Either issue documented final 100 acceptance with evidence and explicit remaining release gates, or reject and return exact task IDs.
tasks.evidence: High final verdict with SHA and nondelegable evidence references; release never auto-approved.
